title: Orthodontic Benefit Riders Claims Note — Records Visit Already Allowed Under the Dental PPO Plan
content:
**Orthodontic Benefit Riders and Dental PPO Plans: the new orthodontist's records visit.** Records that the orthodontist now treating the patient took when the case moved to that practice are part of the case fee. A records visit already allowed under the patient's own Dental PPO Plans enrollment is therefore not counted a second time in the recognised covered-treatment fee.

**The records visit** is the date of the latest paid comprehensive oral evaluation line (code D0150) of that dental enrollment billed under the participation agreement named on the latest transfer entry.

| What the dental enrollment's paid lines show | Amount taken off |
|---|---|
| the records visit also has a paid panoramic image line (code D0330) under the same agreement | the allowed amounts of the evaluation and panoramic lines of that date |
| the records visit has only the evaluation line | its allowed amount |
| no paid D0150 line under that agreement | nothing |
| any lines, when the latest transfer entry names no agreement | nothing |

## Reading the lines

- **Latest** is judged by date of service.
- **The amounts taken off** are allowed amounts, not plan payments.
- **The panoramic line counts only when it falls on the date of the records visit.** A D0330 line on a different date from the latest D0150 line is not part of that visit.

*Hypothetical figures:* the latest paid D0150 line under the new orthodontist's agreement is dated 9 May, with an allowed amount of 74.00. A paid D0330 line on 9 May has an allowed amount of 112.00, so 186.00 is taken off. If the D0330 line were dated 2 May instead, only 74.00 would be taken off.
